paper_title: FreqKV Frequency Domain Key-Value Compression for Efficient Context   Window Extension
caption: : Perplexity evaluation on the validation set of PG-19 with different retaining ratios.
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the perplexity (PPL) on the validation set of PG-19 as a function of evaluation context length for three different retaining ratios (γ = 0.25, 0.5, 0.75) in the FreqKV compression method. The x-axis, labeled “Evaluation Context Length,” is on a linear scale ranging from 2K to 64K tokens, with tick marks at 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K. The y-axis, labeled “PPL,” is also linear, spanning from 7.7 to 8.2, with major ticks at 0.1 intervals. The blue line (γ=0.25) starts at approximately 8.2 at 2K, drops sharply to ~7.85 at 4K, then gradually declines to ~7.78 at 64K. The orange line (γ=0.5) begins at ~8.2, falls to ~7.75 at 8K, and stabilizes near 7.73 at 64K. The green line (γ=0.75) starts at ~8.2, drops to ~7.75 at 8K, and slightly decreases to ~7.72 at 64K. All three lines show a steep initial drop in perplexity as context length increases from 2K to 8K, followed by a much slower decline or plateau beyond 8K, with higher γ values consistently achieving lower perplexity across all context lengths.
